title: LBM_isca: a Linear Baroclinic Model on the Isca/GFDL spectral core
description: LBM_isca is a moist, dynamics-only Linear Baroclinic Model whose dynamical core is a linearisation of the Isca / GFDL atmos_spectral primitive equations (Simmons–Burridge vertical differencing, pure-sigma coordinate, semi-implicit leapfrog with a Robert–Asselin filter), at T42 L20 on a numpy (CPU) or CuPy (CUDA GPU) backend. Because it is re-derived from the GPLv3 Isca sources rather than from the proprietary Watanabe–Kimoto ln_solver, it can be distributed freely under the GPL.
